source: Forge category Themes and full-text matches for camino and theme_camino, with comments, plus feedback from the core team (2026-09-30). As of 2026-10-05.

items.problem: Unclear what an integrator may change.
items.solution: Site settings for colours, fonts, spacing and logo; own CSS, JS and template folder.

items.problem: Search, login and forms look unstyled.
items.solution: Search in the header, a login with a demo account and forms, all built from the theme's parts.

items.problem: fluid_styled_content can break every element.
items.solution: The theme renders its elements itself and loads fluid_styled_content first; a conflict shows an error.

items.problem: File downloads need fluid_styled_content.
items.solution: The Downloads list takes files; name, type and size come from the file.

items.problem: The menu cannot be used with a keyboard.
items.solution: Menus open with buttons and close with Escape.

items.problem: Keyboard focus in the slider is hard to see.
items.solution: A visible focus ring on the slider and its dots.

items.problem: The logo link has no name for screen readers.
items.solution: The logo link carries the site name.

items.problem: Elements can be saved empty.
items.solution: Title and link are required fields.

items.problem: Elements use generic icons.
items.solution: 20 own icons, drawn to the TYPO3 icon grid.

items.problem: Backend layouts have no preview.
items.solution: A screenshot for every layout.

items.problem: Backend previews are unused or print raw HTML.
items.solution: One escaped preview per element.

items.problem: The site shows the theme's name, not its own.
items.solution: Header and footer show the website title.

items.problem: The demo is weak for search engines.
items.solution: Page titles, descriptions, one H1 per page, sitemap and structured data.

items.problem: Pages are never cached by browsers.
items.solution: Core behaviour, kept; the README explains how to switch on cache headers.

items.problem: The theme installs itself unasked, or not at all in DDEV.
items.solution: Theme and demo are two packages; DDEV installs both on the first start.

items.problem: The demo import is incomplete or outdated.
items.solution: One command rebuilds and exports the demo; it requires the import extension.

items.problem: No dark mode switch and no language menu.
items.solution: Both in the header.

items.problem: Templates use older APIs.
items.solution: Templates read records and render content areas the current way.

items.problem: Unclear whether the theme is a starting point or a demo.
items.solution: Theme and demo are separate. Open: a small starter set to choose in the demo.

items.problem: Documentation is missing.
items.solution: README and this Storybook. Open: documentation in the docs.typo3.org format.

items.problem: A page without a backend layout fails.
items.solution: The demo sets layouts. Open: a test with an empty site.

items.problem: Focus rings are clipped or too round.
items.solution: Rings are plain outlines with offset; not yet tested on every card.

items.problem: Labels missing in backend previews.
items.solution: Not yet checked label by label.

items.problem: Command line setup prints a warning.
items.solution: Setup here runs through DDEV; the command line route is untested.

items.problem: Social links: focus and Mastodon URLs.
items.solution: The theme has no social links element.

items.problem: Lists in rich text render invalid HTML.
items.solution: Caused by the core theme's own rich text setup; this theme uses the core's.

items.problem: A global text width misaligns elements.
items.solution: Widths are set per component.

items.problem: Details of the core theme's demo and package.
items.solution: Own demo content and package.
